page.layout: One page of text with two diagrams in the centre; a marginal note block in the left margin beside the lower text. Running head at top; page number at top left.

main_text.head: Canones.
main_text.p: I. Ad retentionem primæ figuræ selige latum mufei quadratum, novem distinctum locis, hoc ordine:
main_text.l: C F B / H K I / D G E (square diagram with inner square K)

p.i: vel si mavis, procede hoc ordine:

main_text.l: D E F / C K G / B I H (square diagram with inner square K)
main_text.p: Rotunda figura est memoriæ inimica.Rotundam figuram, tanquam memoriæ inimicam, fugimus, & angularem eidem familiarem selegimus. Rotunda autem figura discursui est aptissima.
II. Prima figura est circularis, & constat lineis transversalibus, quibus indicatur, elementa ejus

page.notes: The left margin holds a note block, partly visible and faded, of which only the line "Rotunda figura est memoriæ inimica" is legible. Fragments of earlier text show through the page and are omitted. The diagram letters are transcribed as printed; the inner square carries K in both figures.
